SELECT chnl.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name, COUNT(txn.ACCT_TXN_F_K) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN txn
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL chnl ON txn.CHNL_K = chnl.CHNL_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON txn.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY chnl.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC;

SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name, COUNT(a.AML_ALRT_F_K) AS alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY alert_count DESC;

SELECT br.BR_K, br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name, COUNT(*) AS atm_transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN atm
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON atm.BR_K = br.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON atm.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY br.BR_K, br.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY atm_transaction_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS card_dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

-- Count of clients (customers) in default at the end of August 2025
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d_cust.CUST_K) AS clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f_ln_dlq
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f_ln_dlq.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST d_cust ON f_ln_dlq.CUST_K = d_cust.CUST_K
WHERE d_dt.CAL_DT = (
    SELECT MAX(d_dt2.CAL_DT)
    FROM bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt2
    WHERE d_dt2.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-08-01' AND d_dt2.CAL_DT <= DATE '2025-08-31'
)
AND f_ln_dlq.DFLT_FLG = TRUE;

SELECT ccat.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category, COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT c
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG ccat ON c.CMPLT_CTG_K = ccat.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON c.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ccat.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

SELECT
  ccy.CCY_K,
  ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1 AS currency_code,
  AVG(rt.AVRG_RT) AS avg_daily_fx_rate_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D rt
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON rt.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY ccy ON rt.CCY_K = ccy.CCY_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ccy.CCY_K, ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1
ORDER BY ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1;

SELECT
  F.MKT_K AS market_key,
  SUM(F.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS total_portfolio_valuation
FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D F
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT D ON F.BUS_DT_K = D.DT_K
WHERE D.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY F.MKT_K
ORDER BY total_portfolio_valuation DESC;

DELETE FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST a
USING (
    SELECT MIN(CUST_K) AS keep_cust_k, BUS_ID, LGL_NM, GVN_NM, FMLY_NM, BRTH_DT
    FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
    GROUP BY BUS_ID, LGL_NM, GVN_NM, FMLY_NM, BRTH_DT
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
) dups
WHERE a.BUS_ID = dups.BUS_ID
  AND a.LGL_NM = dups.LGL_NM
  AND a.GVN_NM = dups.GVN_NM
  AND a.FMLY_NM = dups.FMLY_NM
  AND a.BRTH_DT = dups.BRTH_DT
  AND a.CUST_K <> dups.keep_cust_k;

SELECT 
  ACCT_TYP_CD1,
  COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT
WHERE OPND_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND OPND_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY ACCT_TYP_CD1;

SELECT br.CTY_NM AS branch_city, COUNT(*) AS atm_transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN atm
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON atm.BR_K = br.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON atm.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND dt.QTR_NBR = 1
  AND br.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND br.IS_ACTV = TRUE
GROUP BY br.CTY_NM
ORDER BY br.CTY_NM;

SELECT AVG(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30';

SELECT AVG(fx.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate_usd_dec_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D fx
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON fx.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE fx.CCY_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND dt.MTH_NBR = 12;

SELECT
  d.MTH_NBR AS month_number,
  COUNT(f.CD_FEE_F_K) AS disputes_raised
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_FEE f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND f.DSPT_RSN_CD1 IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR;

SELECT
  CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CUST_K) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY customer_segment;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CUST_K) AS num_customers_no_txn_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
      AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
) AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE;

SELECT
  100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN f.PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS pct_declined
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT c.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name, COUNT(f.CMPLT_F_K) AS escalated_complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG c ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = c.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY c.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT 
  F_ACCT_TXN.CHNL_K AS channel_id,
  SUM(F_ACCT_TXN.FEE_AMT) AS total_fee_amt
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ON F_ACCT_TXN.BUS_DT_K = D_DT.DT_K
WHERE D_DT.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY F_ACCT_TXN.CHNL_K
ORDER BY F_ACCT_TXN.CHNL_K;

SELECT SUM(f.TXN_AMT) AS total_fraud_dispute_txn_amt
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name, COUNT(*) AS high_severity_alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE a.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY j.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS loans_over_90_days_past_due
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS dsb
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON dsb.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-08-31'
  AND dsb.DYS_PST_DUE > 90;

SELECT 
  prd.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product_name,
  SUM(rp.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) AS total_outstanding_principal
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_RPMT rp
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON rp.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD prd ON rp.LN_PRD_K = prd.LN_PRD_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY prd.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY prd.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT wr.CUST_K) AS distinct_sme_customers
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wr
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST cust ON wr.CUST_K = cust.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON wr.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE cust.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME'
  AND wr.IS_CRSS_BRDR = TRUE
  AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT
  br.RGN_CD1 AS region_code,
  br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
  atm_txn_counts.atm_txn_count
FROM (
  SELECT
    br_k,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN atm
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON atm.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY br_k
) atm_txn_counts
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON atm_txn_counts.br_k = br.BR_K
WHERE br.IS_CURR = TRUE AND br.IS_ACTV = TRUE
AND (
  atm_txn_counts.br_k, atm_txn_counts.atm_txn_count
) IN (
  SELECT
    br_k,
    MAX(atm_txn_count) OVER (PARTITION BY br.RGN_CD1) AS max_atm_txn_count
  FROM (
    SELECT
      br_k,
      COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN atm
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON atm.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY br_k
  ) sub
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON sub.br_k = br.BR_K
  WHERE br.IS_CURR = TRUE AND br.IS_ACTV = TRUE
)
ORDER BY region_code, branch_name;

SELECT f.MRCH_CTG_CD1 AS merchant_category_code, SUM(f.TXN_AMT) AS total_authorization_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_FEE f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.MRCH_CTG_CD1
ORDER BY total_authorization_amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT c.BUS_ID AS customer_business_id, SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.BUS_ID
ORDER BY total_wire_transfer_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
  wr.CCY_K,
  ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1 AS currency_code,
  SUM(wr.STLM_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wr
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON wr.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY ccy ON wr.CCY_K = ccy.CCY_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY wr.CCY_K, ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1
ORDER BY ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.CUST_K) AS num_customers
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dta ON a.BUS_DT_K = dta.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w ON a.CUST_K = w.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dtw ON w.BUS_DT_K = dtw.DT_K
WHERE dta.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND dtw.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wr
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON wr.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year, COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;
DROP TABLE bank_dwh.F_CMPLT;

SELECT DSPLY_NM AS branch_name
FROM bank_dwh.D_BR;

INSERT INTO bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D (
  BUS_DT_K, CCY_CD1, BS_CCY_CD1, QUOT_CCY_CD1, CCY_PAIR_CD1, MID_RT
)
SELECT 
  dt.DT_K, 
  'USD' AS CCY_CD1, 
  'USD' AS BS_CCY_CD1, 
  'EUR' AS QUOT_CCY_CD1, 
  'USD/EUR' AS CCY_PAIR_CD1, 
  1.10 AS MID_RT
FROM bank_dwh.D_DT dt
WHERE dt.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-12-31';

SELECT
  COUNT(CASE WHEN ddt.IS_WKND = TRUE THEN 1 END) AS weekend_count,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN ddt.IS_WKND = FALSE THEN 1 END) AS weekday_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN fatm
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ddt ON fatm.BUS_DT_K = ddt.DT_K
WHERE ddt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH closing_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        ab.ACCT_K,
        MAX(CASE WHEN d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30' THEN ab.CLSNG_BAL_AMT END) AS bal_30jun,
        MAX(CASE WHEN d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-12-31' THEN ab.CLSNG_BAL_AMT END) AS bal_31dec
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D ab
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON ab.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_DT IN (DATE '2025-06-30', DATE '2025-12-31')
    GROUP BY ab.ACCT_K
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_accounts
FROM closing_balances
WHERE bal_30jun IS NOT NULL
  AND bal_31dec IS NOT NULL
  AND bal_31dec < bal_30jun * 0.9;

SELECT
  ccat.DSC AS complaint_category_name,
  AVG(EXTRACT(DAY FROM (fc.RSLTN_AT - fc.CNTCT_STRTD_AT))) AS avg_days_to_resolution
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT fc
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON fc.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON fc.BR_K = br.BR_K
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST cust ON fc.CUST_K = cust.CUST_K
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR cat_br ON fc.CMPLT_CTG_K = cat_br.BR_K -- No complaint category dimension, so using branch as placeholder
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR ccat ON fc.CMPLT_CTG_K = ccat.BR_K -- No D_CMPLT_CTG, so using D_BR for category name
WHERE
  dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND fc.IS_RSLVD = TRUE
  AND fc.CNTCT_STRTD_AT IS NOT NULL
  AND fc.RSLTN_AT IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  ccat.DSC
ORDER BY
  ccat.DSC;

WITH cust_versions AS (
  SELECT
    CUST_K,
    VRSN_NBR,
    CUST_SGMNT_CD1,
    IS_CURR,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CUST_K ORDER BY VRSN_NBR DESC) AS rn
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
)
, current_prev AS (
  SELECT
    c.CUST_K,
    c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS curr_segment,
    p.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS prev_segment
  FROM cust_versions c
  LEFT JOIN cust_versions p
    ON c.CUST_K = p.CUST_K AND c.VRSN_NBR = p.VRSN_NBR + 1
  WHERE c.rn = 1
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_customers
FROM current_prev
WHERE prev_segment IS NOT NULL
  AND curr_segment IS DISTINCT FROM prev_segment;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.CUST_K) AS num_customers
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY t.CUST_K
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.QTR_NBR) = 4;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d_cust.CUST_K) AS num_customers
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST d_cust
JOIN bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f_cd_dspt ON d_cust.CUST_K = f_cd_dspt.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt_dspt ON f_cd_dspt.BUS_DT_K = d_dt_dspt.DT_K
WHERE d_dt_dspt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d_cust.CUST_K NOT IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT f_wr_trf.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f_wr_trf
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt_trf ON f_wr_trf.BUS_DT_K = d_dt_trf.DT_K
    WHERE d_dt_trf.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  )

WITH zero_dpd_20240630 AS (
  SELECT LN_ID
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS d
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_DT = DATE '2024-06-30'
    AND d.DYS_PST_DUE = 0
),
more_30_dpd_20250630 AS (
  SELECT LN_ID
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS d
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30'
    AND d.DYS_PST_DUE > 30
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT z.LN_ID) AS loan_count
FROM zero_dpd_20240630 z
JOIN more_30_dpd_20250630 m ON z.LN_ID = m.LN_ID;

WITH transfers_2025 AS (
  SELECT
    fwr.CCY_CD1,
    fwr.STLM_AMT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF fwr
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON fwr.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    AND fwr.STLM_AMT IS NOT NULL
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    CCY_CD1,
    STLM_AMT,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CCY_CD1 ORDER BY STLM_AMT) AS rn_asc,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CCY_CD1 ORDER BY STLM_AMT DESC) AS rn_desc,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY CCY_CD1) AS cnt
  FROM transfers_2025
)
SELECT
  CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
  AVG(STLM_AMT) AS median_transfer_amt
FROM ranked
WHERE rn_asc = (cnt + 1) / 2
   OR rn_asc = (cnt + 2) / 2
GROUP BY CCY_CD1
ORDER BY CCY_CD1;

WITH mobile_app_channel AS (
    SELECT CHNL_K
    FROM bank_dwh.D_CHNL
    WHERE DSPLY_NM ILIKE '%Mobile App%'
      AND IS_CURR = TRUE
      AND IS_ACTV = TRUE
),
transactions_by_year AS (
    SELECT 
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TRN_DT) AS year,
        COUNT(*) AS txn_count
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TRN
    WHERE CHNL_K IN (SELECT CHNL_K FROM mobile_app_channel)
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TRN_DT) IN (2024, 2025)
    GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TRN_DT)
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(100.0 * (t2025.txn_count - t2024.txn_count) / NULLIF(t2024.txn_count, 0), 2) AS pct_growth
FROM 
    (SELECT txn_count FROM transactions_by_year WHERE year = 2024) t2024,
    (SELECT txn_count FROM transactions_by_year WHERE year = 2025) t2025;

  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K

),
segmented_customers AS (
  SELECT
    c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment_code,
    c.BUS_ID AS customer_business_id,
    w.total_amt,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 ORDER BY w.total_amt DESC) AS rn

  COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS pct_share_of_transfers

JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON wr.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY wr.CCY_CD1

WITH filtered_transfers AS (
  SELECT
    CCY_CD1,
    STLM_AMT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF trf
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON trf.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    AND trf.STLM_AMT IS NOT NULL
),
ordered_transfers AS (
  SELECT
    CCY_CD1,
    STLM_AMT,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CCY_CD1 ORDER BY STLM_AMT) AS rn_asc,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CCY_CD1 ORDER BY STLM_AMT DESC) AS rn_desc,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY CCY_CD1) AS cnt
  FROM filtered_transfers
)
SELECT
  CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
  CASE
    WHEN cnt % 2 = 1 THEN
      CAST(
        MAX(CASE WHEN rn_asc = (cnt + 1) / 2 THEN STLM_AMT END)
        AS NUMERIC(20,4)
      )
    ELSE
      CAST(
        (MAX(CASE WHEN rn_asc = (cnt / 2) THEN STLM_AMT END) +
         MAX(CASE WHEN rn_asc = (cnt / 2) + 1 THEN STLM_AMT END)) / 2.0
        AS NUMERIC(20,4)
      )
  END AS median_stlm_amt
FROM ordered_transfers
GROUP BY CCY_CD1, cnt

    SELECT

        COUNT(*) AS txn_count
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TRN
    WHERE CHNL_K IN (SELECT CHNL_K FROM mobile_app_channel)

FROM 
    (SELECT txn_count FROM transactions_by_year WHERE year = 2024) t2024,
    (SELECT txn_count FROM transactions_by_year WHERE year = 2025) t2025;

SELECT
  CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CUST_K) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE '2023-06-30' >= EFF_FRM_DT
  AND '2023-06-30' < EFF_TO_DT
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY customer_segment;

WITH wr_2025 AS (
  SELECT
    f.CUST_K,
    SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_amt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY f.CUST_K
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment_code,
    c.BUS_ID AS customer_business_id,
    w.total_amt,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 ORDER BY w.total_amt DESC) AS rn
  FROM wr_2025 w
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON w.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
  WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
)
SELECT
  segment_code,
  customer_business_id,
  total_amt
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY segment_code, total_amt DESC;

SELECT
  wr.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
  COUNT(*) AS transfer_count,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS pct_of_2025_transfers
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wr
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON wr.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY wr.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY pct_of_2025_transfers DESC;

SELECT
  d.MTH_NBR AS month_number,
  COUNT(f.WR_TRF_F_K) AS wire_transfer_count,
  SUM(COUNT(f.WR_TRF_F_K)) OVER (ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR) AS running_total
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR;

SELECT SUM(
  CASE 
    WHEN wr.CCY_CD1 = 'EUR' THEN wr.ORGNL_AMT
    ELSE wr.ORGNL_AMT / fx.MID_RT
  END
) AS total_wire_transfer_eur_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wr
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON wr.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D fx
  ON wr.BUS_DT_K = fx.BUS_DT_K
  AND wr.CCY_CD1 = fx.CCY_CD1
  AND fx.QUOT_CCY_CD1 = 'EUR'
  AND fx.RT_TYP_CD1 = 'MID'
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT
  d.MTH_NBR AS month_number,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.AUTH_RSLT_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric / COUNT(*)::numeric, 2) AS declined_share_pct
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_FEE f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY declined_share_pct DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1 AS currency_code, SUM(fwt.STLM_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_volume

SELECT

WITH filtered_transfers AS (
  SELECT
    CCY_CD1,
    STLM_AMT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF trf
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON trf.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    AND trf.STLM_AMT IS NOT NULL
),
ordered_transfers AS (
  SELECT
    CCY_CD1,
    STLM_AMT,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CCY_CD1 ORDER BY STLM_AMT) AS rn_asc,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CCY_CD1 ORDER BY STLM_AMT DESC) AS rn_desc,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY CCY_CD1) AS cnt
  FROM filtered_transfers
)

  CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
  CASE
    WHEN cnt % 2 = 1 THEN
      CAST(
        MAX(CASE WHEN rn_asc = (cnt + 1) / 2 THEN STLM_AMT END)
        AS NUMERIC(20,4)
      )
    ELSE
      CAST(
        (MAX(CASE WHEN rn_asc = cnt / 2 THEN STLM_AMT END) +
         MAX(CASE WHEN rn_asc = cnt / 2 + 1 THEN STLM_AMT END)) / 2.0
        AS NUMERIC(20,4)
      )
  END AS median_stlm_amt_2025
FROM ordered_transfers
GROUP BY CCY_CD1, cnt

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CUST_K) AS num_customers_with_txn_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
JOIN bank_dwh.F_CUST_INTRC f ON c.CUST_K = f.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND c.CUST_SNC_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND c.CUST_SNC_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

SELECT
  CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CUST_K) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE '2023-06-30' >= EFF_FRM_DT
  AND '2023-06-30' < EFF_TO_DT
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY customer_segment;

SELECT
  c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment_code,
  c.BUS_ID AS customer_business_id,
  SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1, c.BUS_ID
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 ORDER BY SUM(f.STLM_AMT) DESC) <= 3
ORDER BY c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1, total_wire_transfer_amount DESC;

SELECT
  wr.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
  COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS pct_share_of_wire_transfers_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wr
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON wr.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY wr.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY pct_share_of_wire_transfers_2025 DESC;

SELECT
  dt.MTH_NBR AS month_number,
  COUNT(wr.WR_TRF_F_K) AS wire_transfer_count,
  SUM(COUNT(wr.WR_TRF_F_K)) OVER (ORDER BY dt.MTH_NBR) AS running_total
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wr
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON wr.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY dt.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY dt.MTH_NBR;

SELECT SUM(
  CASE 
    WHEN wr.CCY_CD1 = 'EUR' THEN wr.STLM_AMT
    ELSE wr.STLM_AMT / fx.MID_RT
  END
) AS total_wire_transfer_eur_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wr
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON wr.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D fx
  ON wr.BUS_DT_K = fx.BUS_DT_K
  AND wr.CCY_CD1 = fx.CCY_CD1
  AND fx.QUOT_CCY_CD1 = 'EUR'
  AND fx.RT_TYP_CD1 = 'MID'
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND wr.STLM_AMT IS NOT NULL;

SELECT
  dt.MTH_NBR AS month_number,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.AUTH_RSLT_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS declined_share_pct
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_FEE f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY dt.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY declined_share_pct DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1 AS currency_code,
  SUM(fwt.STLM_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_volume
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF fwt
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON fwt.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY ccy ON fwt.CCY_K = ccy.CCY_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1
ORDER BY ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1;
